artworks.title: Désillusion!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a storefront scene with a ladder. The drawing depicts an exterior scene beside a building labeled "EPICERIES" with a tall, leaning ladder propped against it. There is one figure standing in front of the others next to the ladder. Above, the words "CARICATURES DU JOUR" suggest the publication context for this drawing. At the bottom, the word "DÉSILLUSION!" sits above a paragraph of French text. The use of shading and line work gives depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Divertissement ... renouvelé des Grecs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an aquatic scene with figures in a natural landscape. The central focus includes two figures submerged in water, with their heads and flowing hair visible. To the right, another figure is standing on the shore, appearing to interact with another seated figure under a tree. The landscape is sketched with loose, wavy lines depicting water and trees, rendered in strokes that capture movement and texture.

artworks.title: Une nouvelle maniére de descendre le fleuve de la vie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a boating mishap on a river near a city with buildings and a bridge. The image shows a capsized boat and individuals struggling in the water, while others row a small boat in the background. The cityscape includes buildings, an embankment, and a bridge over the river. The artwork humorously portrays the chaotic scene with exaggerated expressions and gestures. The drawing is monochromatic and sketch-like, with some speech included in the image.

artworks.title: Cristi! ... Notre canot a rompu son amarre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing on a sandy shore looking over a body of water with a drifting boat. They are depicted on the right side, with one man standing slightly behind the other. In the background, there are hills or islands with a faintly visible lighthouse. The illustration features distinctive linework and shading for light and shadow. The color palette is monochrome with various tones of gray, giving it a graphite drawing aesthetic. The open water stretches towards the horizon, creating a sense of space and depth.

artworks.title: Combat Naval
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two boats engaged in a water fight on a river. The scene shows the occupants of two small boats splashing water at each other. There is a building in the background on the riverbank. The characters in the boats are expressive and exaggerated, indicating a sense of fun and competition. The style is caricature-like, emphasizing humor and exaggeration. The drawing is detailed, capturing the movement and dynamic between the two boats and their occupants.

artworks.title: Et ... Voila ...Les voyageurs qui nous passent devant le nez!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three people from the waist up, positioned side by side facing to the right. The person on the left is leaning back slightly, with their head tilted upward and hands clasped in front. The middle person also has their head slightly angled back and shares a similar posture. The rightmost person stands more erect, with their arms crossed. All three have elongated facial features, most notably long, exaggerated noses. They wear hats, with the two on the left in top hats, and the one on the right in a slightly broader-brimmed hat. Their hair is mostly hidden under their headwear. The individuals are dressed in formal attire, characterized by coats and cravats. Surrounding them is a wooden fence, and in the background, a steam train is seen passing in the distance. A building labeled "POSTE AUX CHEVAUX" is visible behind the leftmost person. The setting appears to be outdoors, with the open landscape continuing into the background, over which the train moves.

artworks.title: Le danger de s'assoupir en voyage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. One is leaning out of a train window, looking surprised. The other is on a train station platform, gesturing towards the person in the window. The scene is in black and white, showing basic outlines without intricate details.

artworks.title: Eh! Mère Godichet c'est pas étonnant ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two elderly figures engaged in conversation. The image depicts two characters standing within an interior setting; one figure is leaning on a broom, listening intently, while the other leans forward. The drawing style features intricate lines and shading, emphasizing the textures of their garments and expressions. The scene plays out in a domestic environment, suggested by the presence of the broom and casual attire. The background is minimal, drawing focus to the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Quand tu étais dans ton village t'aurais ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a scene. The man on the left is standing with one arm outstretched, wearing a soldier's uniform with a cross on his chest, a long coat, and a decorative hat. The man on the right is hunched over, leaning on a stick, and carrying a sack on his back. The background includes faint outlines of other figures, suggesting a crowd. The artwork includes text at the top and sketched-out lines below it.

artworks.title: François, qui est-ce qui a bu mon vin ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men interacting in a room. Three men are in conversation, with one man standing and gesturing towards two men seated at a table. The man on the left is holding a bottle and appears to be explaining something, while the man next to him listens. The room has framed pictures on the wall, creating a cozy setting. The drawing features a humorous and exaggerated style, capturing the expressions and body language of the men.

artworks.title: Le jardin des Tuileries
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing outdoors. The central man on the left is in profile, wearing a uniform with tassels on the shoulders and a tall hat, holding a walking stick. The two men on the right are facing him, dressed in 19th-century clothing with long coats and top hats. One man is gesturing with his hand. They are in a garden with a large tree in the background. The image is monochrome with an illustrative style, possibly from an older publication. There are faint outlines of other figures or objects in the background.

artworks.title: Merci! Ce monsieur m'invite a chasser ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men represented in a cartoon-style sketch. One man is hunched over, walking barefoot, carrying a large bundle over his shoulder, and holding a gun. He wears a cap, a jacket, and shorts. The other man stands upright, holding a gun and a small bird. He wears a flat cap, a jacket, a buttoned vest, and trousers. The background is a simple outdoor scene with minimal detail, hinting at open land or fields, with faded ink text and illustrations behind the drawing.

artworks.title: Un jour de grande tenue
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of two individuals from the waist up. On the left, a person stands in profile view with a mustache, short hair, and a tall, cylindrical hat. They wear a military uniform with shoulder decorations and a strap across the chest. On the right, another individual faces forward in a saluting gesture with exaggerated features and wavy hair under a large military hat. They also wear a military uniform with decorative buttons. The background shows a newspaper or printed page with unclear text.

artworks.title: Le mardi gras
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men facing each other. The man on the left has an elongated face, tired eyes, a long nose, and thin lips. He wears a hat, a vest, and a ruffled shirt with a neckerchief. The man on the right has a rounded face, a raised eyebrow, and a hat with a large feather. He wears a white ruffled shirt and a dark vest. The background has a cross-hatched texture. There is text at the bottom related to "Le Mardi Gras."

artworks.title: Un article louangeur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted closely together. On the left, a man is leaning towards the woman on his left. He has a beard, mustache, and long hair, wearing a dark coat. On the right, a woman is seated, holding a piece of paper. She wears glasses and has medium-length hair. She is dressed in light-colored clothing covered by a shawl. The backdrop indicates a possible domestic setting. No visible jewelry is present, and decorative elements suggest this might be an illustration in a published work.

artworks.title: Un homme a la mer
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a small rowboat at sea, one on the right holding a pole extended into the water while the other on the left reaches downward. A third person is in the water up to their waist, with arms submerged. The background features calm waters, a distant landmass, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Un léger manuscrit
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated facing each other, both visible from the waist up. The man on the left is leaning forward with his hands clasped on his lap. He has a thin face, dark hair styled back, and is wearing formal attire. The man on the right is adjusting his spectacles while holding a sheet of paper. He has a round face, prominent chin, light hair, and is also in formal attire. The background is a lightly sketched interior with a focus on the men. The drawing style is detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Les satanés séducteurs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two elderly men standing side by side from the waist up. The man on the left is in profile, facing right, with a prominent hooked nose and furrowed brow. He has short, gray hair under a tall, black top hat and is dressed in a dark jacket, waistcoat, and white shirt. He appears to be holding a pair of eyeglasses. The man on the right faces slightly forward, with a mischievous smile and gray hair under his top hat. He wears a light-colored coat, buttoned at the front, with a bow tie around his neck. The background has a shaded area with textured patterns and lighter space above with printed text headings and hand-drawn details.

artworks.title: Le vin de propriétaire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two older men waist up, facing each other in conversation. The man on the left has a long nose, set eyes, prominent cheekbones, thin combed back hair, and wears a dark suit with a high-collared shirt. The man on the right has wide eyes, a broad nose, short wavy hair, and a focused expression while holding a cup. He wears a dark top. There is a small round table with a dark wine bottle on it. The background is sketchy and shadowy, highlighting the interaction between the men. They are in an informal setting, possibly a home or a small establishment.

artworks.title: Carotte du calicot
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals from the waist up in a store. On the left, an elderly person wears a bonnet, dark shawl, and a serious expression, looking down at fabric. On the right, a person with distinct cheekbones and short hair leans over a counter, holding patterned fabric. Additional fabric bundles are stacked behind the elderly woman, and the room has light-colored paneling. In the background are more figures, indicating a busy store setting.

artworks.title: Le portrait au daguéréotype
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. The man on the left is shown in profile, holding a board or a photograph. He is dressed in a dark suit with checkered trousers. The woman beside him is standing upright, wearing light-colored clothing with a dark shawl. A child, facing away, stands next to them. The setting includes a camera setup and framed pictures on the wall, suggesting an interior scene.

artworks.title: Désolé ... Je suis de la société des philantropes du nord ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures and one child standing on a street. To the left, a man stands, slightly leaning back, with one hand in his coat pocket. He is wearing a tall black top hat, a long black coat that reaches past his knees, and black pants. His facial features are not very detailed, but he is wearing glasses and has shoulder-length hair. On the right, a woman with a scarf tied around her head holds a swaddled infant securely in her arms. She is dressed in a long-sleeved dress with a shawl around her shoulders and is barefoot. Beside her is a young child, who is tugging at her dress, wearing a vest over a long-sleeved shirt and tattered pants. The background shows tall buildings lining the street, suggesting an urban setting.

artworks.title: Monsieur, je souscris pour le temblement de terre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a person in an office setting, communicating through a screened window. One person is standing on one side of a partition, leaning forward to speak with another person seated on the other side. The standing person is dressed in formal attire from an older era, with a long coat and knee-length trousers. There is a top hat on the counter between them. The partition has a grid-like pattern, suggesting a barrier, and the interior seems to be an office, with the seated figure holding a writing instrument. The artwork is part of a series called "Les Philanthropes du Jour."

artworks.title: Hier dans la rue Saint-Honoré ... unviellard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of three men in an indoor setting. Two men are seated at a table, and one man is standing nearby. The seated man on the left has bushy hair and a pointed nose, wearing a dark suit and a light-colored shirt. The other seated man is facing him and is holding a large newspaper that conceals most of his face except for a part of his profile, showing a receding hairline and sideburns; he is dressed in a dark suit as well. On the table, there are bottles, a carafe, and round objects resembling plates or small bowls. The standing man in the background, to the right, also has a receding hairline and subtle features at his distance from the viewer; he holds a piece of paper. The background has a textured design resembling arches or columns.
